issues.on_page: General Fund (Governmental Fund Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances)
issues.issue: Extractor rules list airport authorities as entirely business-type entities (all lines business-type, balances in business_type, governmental fields null). This extraction records everything as governmental because the report presents a single governmental General Fund. Defensible from the page, but it goes against the stated entity-type rule. All receipts, disbursements and detail lines are affected.

issues.on_page: Single General Fund reported as a governmental fund for an airport authority
issues.issue: decision_needed[] is missing. A person needs to settle whether to treat this airport authority as governmental (as the report presents it) or business-type (as the entity-type rule says).

issues.on_page: Airport operations: Cost of fuel for resale / Operating expenses / Personnel services
issues.issue: disbursements[0-2] and every detail expenditure line use function 'other'. The listed-by-object rule would point to the fund's function (General Fund -> general government) with review. There is no airport function, so this is a judgment call.
The line mixes other taxes with state revenue and no breakdown is printed. 'other taxes' would also be defensible. It is already marked review.
Permit and license fees paid are not dues, training or travel. 'miscellaneous expenditure' or 'professional/contract services' may fit better.
